CONSTANT.label: Constant
CONSTANT.hint: Only users change it. Workflows read it.

SCRIPT.label: Script

errors.tooLarge: The value is larger than 64 KB.

create.subheader: Define a value once and use it in any workflow, connector or notification.

visibility.subheader: Choose which workflows may use the variable.

script.languageLocked: The language can't change after the script is created.
script.codeHint: Must return a value. Read workflow data with ref("…") and a string literal; pass method data in as a parameter where you can.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.hint: Every call fills exactly these parameters. An optional parameter left empty uses its default.
parameters.name: Name

imports.label: Imports
imports.hint: Other script variables of the same language, available as globals.<name>.

errors.tooLarge: The script is larger than 256 KB.
errors.parameters: Parameter names must be unique identifiers (letters, digits, _ or $, not starting with a digit).
errors.VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE: Checking scripts in this language is not available yet

test.title: Test run
test.valueHint: Values are read like a constant: JSON when it parses, otherwise text. An empty reference is null, as at run time.
test.notRun: Run the script with test values to check it before saving.

hints.REPLACE: The run's value replaces the stored one, unless someone changed it during the run.
hints.FORWARD_ONLY: Saved only if it is greater than the stored value (numbers or ISO dates). For cursors.
hints.INCREMENT: Adds the run's number to the stored value. For counters.

hints.ON_SUCCESS: All writes of a run are saved together once it succeeds; a failed run saves nothing.
hints.EACH_WRITE: Saved during the run (at most every 500 ms) and once more at the end, also when the run fails.

owner.label: Owner workflow
owner.hint: The only workflow that may write this variable. Left empty, the first workflow saved with a write claims it.
owner.unclaimed: Claimed by the first workflow that writes it

errors.valueUnfitForPolicy: This value can't be used with the write policy: increment needs a number, forward only a number or an ISO date.
